FPF-ASSETCLASS_REPO_REPO_SUM.name: Qualifying Hedge Funds: repo exposure (U.S. dollars)
FPF-ASSETCLASS_REPO_REPO_SUM.notes: The data are aggregated responses to SEC Form PF. Blank or null values are intentional to avoid potential disclosure of proprietary information of individual filers. Only responses from Qualifying Hedge Funds are included. A repurchase agreement (repo) is a sale of securities coupled with an agreement to repurchase the same, or similar, securities at a later date at an agreed upon price. Repo exposures (cash in and securities out) are reported as short exposures on questions 26 and 30. A reverse repo is any purchase of securities coupled with an agreement to sell the same, or similar, securities at a later date at an agreed upon price. Reverse repo exposures (cash out and securities in) are reported as long exposures on questions 26 and 30. See additional definitions and methodology on the SEC Form PF Data Sets page of the Hedge Fund Monitor.

FPF-ASSETCLASS_LTREASURY_SUM.name: Qualifying Hedge Funds: long U.S. Treasury exposure (U.S. dollars)
FPF-ASSETCLASS_LTREASURY_SUM.notes: The data are aggregated responses to SEC Form PF. Blank or null values are intentional to avoid potential disclosure of proprietary information of individual filers. Only responses from Qualifying Hedge Funds are included. U.S. Treasury exposures are based on SEC Form PF questions 26 and 30. Long Treasury exposures include both cash securities and derivatives, such as Treasury futures, forwards, and options contracts. It generally reflects exposures that stand to increase (or decrease) in value with an increase (or decrease) in the value of the underlying assets. Exposures are reported as duration, weighted average tenor, or 10-year equivalent adjusted. See additional definitions and methodology on the SEC Form PF Data Sets page of the Hedge Fund Monitor.

It generally reflects exposures that stand to increase (or decrease) in value with a decrease (or increase) in the value of the underlying assets. Exposures are reported as duration, weighted average tenor, or 10-year equivalent adjusted. See additional definitions and methodology on the SEC Form PF Data Sets page of the Hedge Fund Monitor.
